en-US:
Release candidate for the App Store (0.7.4): a visual update; no new permission, data use or purchase.
• One headline figure per screen: larger amounts on Today, Plan and Assets, with the currency code a size smaller.
• Savings goals and accounts each keep their own colour; budget bars still show pace in green, amber and red.
• Calmer screens: Plan’s month and period controls sit on the page, goals no longer repeat their icon, and the hide-amounts button matches the toolbar.
• The selection slides between sections in Plan and History; buttons press gently. Amounts never animate; Reduce Motion turns it off.
Please check: every tab in light and dark; a long amount on Assets and Plan (it shrinks to fit, never wraps); a goal and an account keep the same colour everywhere; Plan and History selection with and without Reduce Motion; the hide-amounts button on each tab; Larger Text in Settings › Accessibility.
zh-Hans:
App Store 候选版本（0.7.4）：视觉更新，不涉及新权限、新数据用途或新购买项目。
• 每个页面一个醒目的主金额：今日、规划和资产页金额更大，币种代码缩小一号。
• 储蓄目标和账户各有固定颜色；预算进度条仍用绿、黄、红表示进度。
• 页面更清爽：规划页的月份与周期选择直接放在页面上，目标不再重复显示图标，隐藏金额按钮与工具栏风格一致。
• 在规划和明细中切换时选中标记平滑滑动，按钮按下有轻微回弹。金额从不播放动画；开启“减弱动态效果”后关闭。
请检查：每个标签页的浅色与深色外观；资产和规划页的较长金额（会缩小以适应，不会换行）；同一目标和账户在各处颜色一致；规划和明细的切换（开启与关闭“减弱动态效果”）；每个标签页的隐藏金额按钮；设置 › 辅助功能中的“更大字体”。
